text:
Aisha: Heads-up: targeting rollout for "microcopy-compact" change (service: rn-render) tomorrow 2026-03-23 03:30 UTC. Draft RN: https://internal/redwood/rn/microcopy-compact-2026-03-23.md. Canary in us-east then eu. Need pin+rollback owners and a concise internal blurb.

Alex: I can pin. Planning to stage v1.14.0-q8 at 03:00 UTC and pin once canary looks good.

Nora: Ops wants a 10m canary in us-east-1, then 20m in eu-west-1 before full. If error_rate > 1.5% OR 5xxs > 0.5% run rollback.

Chen: Oncall for the window. I'll set smoke asserts on p95 and 5xx. Please paste the exact deploy command.

DeployBot: deploybot: queued rn-render image v1.14.0-q8 -> canary staging. Use:
```
/deploy rn-render --image=v1.14.0-q8 --env=prod --canary=10m --pin=false
```

Aisha: RN edit: add rollback steps and who to cc (oncall + eng-sre). Also call out user-visible change: shorter snippets in responses.

Alex: Adding rollback snippet
```
# rollback
/deploy rn-render --image=v1.13.7 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: regresion or errors"
```

Nora: Ops thresholds: p95 > baseline +25% OR sustained error_rate >= 1.5% for 5m -> rollback. I'll add runbook ops-runbooks/rn-render-canary.md and link it in the RN.

Chen: Smoke tests: GET /health -> 200; POST /v1/generate with prompt "smoke" and assert token_usage < 140 and latency < 500ms. I'll add these to the CI pipeline.

Priya: I'll take the internal blurb and send to #eng 10 minutes after deploy start. Sam can you handle #customer-success?

Sam: Yup, will post CS note with a short summary and impact line. Will include cost delta if any.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1742251400 (status: canary running) — https://deployboard/redwood/1742251400

Chen: First 3m: p95 +8%, no increase in 5xx. Smoke tests pass.

Nora: Error rate 0.4% in canary so far. Still within thresholds.

Alex: Canary green. Rolling to eu-west at 03:45 UTC (20m).

DeployBot: expanded canary to eu-west at 1742251500 (status: canary expanded).

Chen: eu-west smoke failing on one host (GET /health returned 503). Killing host and re-routing, watching.

Nora: 5xx spike to 0.7% in eu-west; still below rollback threshold but keep close watch.

Chen: Issue isolated to an autoscaler misconfig on a node pool, fixed and health checks recovered.

Alex: Given recovery, continue rollout. I'll pin v1.14.0-q8 to the route at 80% and then 100% after 10m if stable.

DeployBot: pinned v1.14.0-q8 to prod route at 1742251600 (pin=partial).

Priya: Internal blurb uploaded to docs/announce-drafts/microcopy-compact-internal.txt and linked in RN. Posting to #eng at 03:40 UTC.

Sam: Posted to #customer-success with impact notes and mitigations. Added note about token delta: roughly +0.2 tok/op.

Chen: Final 10m observation window started. p95 within +5% of baseline, errors steady.

DeployBot: rollout completed at 1742251700 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: us-east 10m -> eu-west 20m -> full.

Aisha: Great job. Reminder: update external RN to include rollback snippet and cost line before any customer-facing blasts. I'll close the draft after Alex's PR.

Alex: Filing PR now for RN edits and rollback snippet.

Nora: Runbook linked and owners assigned. Marking ops checklist complete. :white_check_mark:

Chen: Posting final canary snapshot to this thread and archiving run logs.

Priya: Thanks team. If anything regresses, use the rollback command and escalate to #eng-oncall.

Sam: Closing the announce loop.
